Syed Shah Mohammed Quadri & S. N. Variava.
JUDGMENT:
                                        J U D G M E N T
        We have today in Civil Appeal No. 2305 of 1994 held that the Appellants
are not entitled to exemption under Notification No. 208/83.   In this case the only
difference is that the inputs are different.  On the reasoning given in that judgment
these inputs would not fall under Sub-Item 8.  Therefore  this  Appeal also stands
dismissed.      There shall be no order as to costs.
